# sreagent_alert_route (Resource)

Where one service's alerts open in Slack.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sreagent_alert_route" "checkout" {
  service = "checkout"
  target  = "#checkout-alerts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service` (String) The service whose alerts this routes. Changing it replaces the route.
- `target` (String) The Slack channel this service's alerts open in.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route is in force.
- `oncall_schedule_id` (String) An on-call schedule whose current person is mentioned in the alert's thread. Removing it clears the mention.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax, or with an `import` block
naming the same ID. See the [importing guide](../guides/importing.md).

```shell
# Collections import by id.
terraform import sreagent_alert_route.checkout 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
